vulnerability_cn: 来源通道验证缺失 + 无抵押铸币
detail_cn: Secret 侧 ics20-for-axelar 的 do_ibc_packet_receive() 只按 denom 查允许列表，未将来源通道绑定到真正的 Axelar。攻击者从自建链发送伪造存款消息，铸出 saTokens，再通过真实通道赎回 Axelar 托管资产。源码为官方披露对应的 Rust 提交 b206182；实际攻击发生于 2026-06-10，索引日期沿用源表。
detail_en: The Secret-side ics20-for-axelar do_ibc_packet_receive() checks the denom allow-list without binding the source channel to genuine Axelar. Forged deposits from an attacker-controlled chain mint unbacked saTokens, which are redeemed through the genuine channel for escrowed assets. Rust source is pinned to the officially identified b206182 revision. The attack occurred on 2026-06-10; the index retains the sheet date.
